verification: Publisher/curator metadata inspected via Figshare API, Zenodo API, and the original authors' public S3 listing. Checksums below are upstream checksums, not locally recomputed checksums.

datasets.representation: Original-author raw pseudobulk expression; genes filtered at >0.01 UMI per cell. Inspect obs before deciding whether X contains sums or means.
datasets.purpose: Fast broad target-response library and mean-effect transfer. Does not retain single-cell distributions.

datasets.representation: Original-author raw pseudobulk expression; genes filtered at >0.01 UMI per cell. Inspect obs before deciding whether X contains sums or means.
datasets.purpose: Second cell context for mean-effect transfer or whole-context holdout. Exclude all RPE1 perturbations from training in an RPE1 holdout.

datasets.representation: Original-author raw pseudobulk expression; genes filtered at >0.01 UMI per cell. Inspect obs before deciding whether X contains sums or means.
datasets.purpose: Small independent screen/timepoint for transfer consistency. This shares the K562 cell line with GWPS and is not a separate cell-line holdout.

datasets.representation: scPerturb harmonized single-cell h5ad, intended raw-count source; verify X/layers, nonnegative integer counts and control labels on ingestion. Not the scPertEval log-normalized processed_complete file.
datasets.purpose: Add liver-derived cell context, real control cells, pseudobulk effects and distribution calibration.

datasets.representation: scPerturb harmonized single-cell h5ad, intended raw-count source; verify X/layers, nonnegative integer counts and control labels on ingestion. Not the scPertEval log-normalized processed_complete file.
datasets.purpose: Add T-cell-derived context, real control cells, pseudobulk effects and distribution calibration.

datasets.representation: scPerturb harmonized single-cell h5ad, intended raw-count source; verify X/layers, nonnegative integer counts and control labels on ingestion. Not the scPertEval log-normalized processed_complete file.
datasets.purpose: Real single-cell populations for a whole-RPE1-context holdout and generator evaluation. The raw bulk is the same biological screen, so cannot be used to train an RPE1-held-out experiment.

datasets.representation: Original-author long-format target-by-expression-gene LFC summary. Header verified from compressed prefix: Target, Expressed_Gene_Symbol, Expressed_Gene_Ens_ID, lfc, pval_adj. Establish log base from original analysis before using exp or exp2. Original Methods and 6b_calc_lfcs_transcriptome_wide_by_gene.R show reported lfc is the mean covariate-adjusted log-expression residual from a control-fitted linear model, not a DESeq2/raw-pseudobulk log2 fold change. Auxiliary plotting scripts call adjusted LFC natural-log units; the separate lfc_unadjusted computation defaults to base 10. Do not exponentiate the reported lfc as log2FC or pool uncalibrated with ordinary count fold changes.
datasets.purpose: Additional pluripotent-context response signatures with broad perturbation coverage. Small summary alternative to ingesting millions of cells; does not contain raw cells, control distribution or sufficient counts for a single-cell generator.

datasets.cell_context: Human iPSC lines, targeted screen averaged over lines
datasets.representation: Original-author mean transcriptional fold-change per target and expressed gene. Verify schema and log base before conversion. Original Methods and 6b_calc_lfcs_transcriptome_wide_by_gene.R show reported lfc is the mean covariate-adjusted log-expression residual from a control-fitted linear model, not a DESeq2/raw-pseudobulk log2 fold change. Auxiliary plotting scripts call adjusted LFC natural-log units; the separate lfc_unadjusted computation defaults to base 10. Do not exponentiate the reported lfc as log2FC or pool uncalibrated with ordinary count fold changes.
datasets.purpose: Small additional target-effect reference and cross-screen consistency check. Do not count rows as independent biological replicates; no raw-cell distribution is supplied.

datasets.cell_context: Primary human CD4+ T cells; four donors; Rest, Stim8hr, Stim48hr
datasets.representation: DESeq2 differential-expression summary, 33983 perturbation-condition rows x 10282 expressed genes. layers['log_fc'] is log2 fold change; other layers include p_value, adj_p_value, baseMean, lfcSE, zscore. Multipart S3 ETag is not an MD5 checksum.
datasets.purpose: Candidate extra source of broad, context-dependent effect signatures. Use guide-quality/off-target flags and context-stratified shrinkage. Not raw cells; cannot directly provide a cell-level count distribution. Download after first eight are in progress.

datasets.representation: scPerturb harmonized single-cell h5ad, intended raw-count source; verify X/layers, nonnegative integer counts and control labels on ingestion.
datasets.purpose: Optional: raw-cell generator experiments or single-cell holdout. The much smaller raw bulk already supplies mean target effects. Defer unless a concrete analysis needs cells.

deferred_sources.cell_context: Primary human CD4+ T cells; four donors x three conditions
deferred_sources.representation: Sum of UMI counts per guide x donor x culture condition over 18129 genes. obs includes n_cells, total_counts, guide_type and quality flags.
deferred_sources.purpose: Deferred: donor-specific control and perturbation means if DE-only signatures are demonstrably useful. Adds 44.57GB and is not required for the first submission.

deferred_sources.representation: Author subset of 1655 strong perturbations plus NTC, all feature genes retained; inspect raw/count layer before use.
deferred_sources.purpose: Deferred until overlap with the final target panel is known. Full pan-genome version is 189393177972B and unnecessary for a first run.
